items.title: Justin Herbert: Likely to play through finger injury
items.text:
Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said that Herbert "should be good to go" for Monday's game at Baltimore after imaging on the quarterback's injured left middle finger returned negative for a fracture, ESPN.com reports.

items.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Likely to miss multiple weeks
items.text:
The knee injury that Stevenson sustained late in the third quarter of Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Packers is expected to keep him out for "the next few weeks," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brian Thomas: Staying put in Jacksonville
items.text:
The Jaguars have relayed to inquiring teams that they intend to keep Thomas through Tuesday's trade deadline, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Terrance Ferguson: Return from IR not guaranteed
items.text:
Rams head coach Sean McVay acknowledged Monday during his appearance on the "Coach McVay Show" that he's hopeful Ferguson (hamstring/ankle) will return from injured reserve this season, but was unwilling to guarantee that the tight end will be activated by the time his 21-day evaluation window closes, Cameron DaSilva of USA Today reports. "I'm reluctant to get too far ahead of anything, just because -- but yes, that is something we'd want to avoid if he's not prepared," McVay said, regarding the possibility of Ferguson being shut down.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Likely to miss at least one month
items.text:
The Rams are expected to place Nacua (knee/toe) on injured reserve in the coming days due to injuries that will likely sideline him for at least one month, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.
